notes:
Passed on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and the hardware/sim backend was not run. The gate never imports the upstream package or the clone, so the fake backend is a pure Python stand-in for chemistrylab.benches.extract_bench:GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 and the upstream environment was not run or compared with it. The fake returns the full observation shape, 3 * (100 + 7) = 321 values (three working vessels, 100 layers and a seven-product one-hot each), but the values are placeholder data; the fidelity gaps say this. NOT COVERED: the chemistry model (vessels, materials, spectra, events and the reward generator), rendering, and snapshot/restore. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed used by the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, observation_space, reset and step, because GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 inherits GenBench through a star import in the clone and the gate's AST resolver cannot follow that base, while all four names occur in the clone; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and seed twice, as for every Gymnasium family driver. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The card's GymnasiumDriver shape was correct, so there is no deviation; only catalogue classes are bound, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
